description:
Code, results and figures for the article "What does a ridge network estimate? Effective penalty and leakage in ridge precision matrix estimation" by Mohammad Arashi and Ebrahim Khaled Ebrahim.

The deposit holds (1) the R scripts of the simulation study and of the stock-return analysis, which produce every number, table and figure of the article and its supplement; (2) their outputs, including the stored replicates from which the tables can be rebuilt without rerunning the simulations; and (3) the R package ridgegraph (source and built package), which implements the ridge precision estimator, the estimated effective penalty, the two-point extrapolation and the multi-penalty permutation selection. The stock data are the stockdata set of the CRAN package huge. See README.md for how to reproduce each table and figure.
